courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public facility/research reference, not an operating entrance or the teaching laboratory.

courses.summary: 東京都下水道局介紹有明採A₂O和生物膜過濾，部分水另經臭氧或纖維過濾供沖廁與清洗等用途。
courses.summaryEn: Tokyo Sewerage describes A₂O and biofilm filtration at Ariake, with part of the water further ozonated or fiber-filtered for toilet flushing and washing.

history.title: 東京有明水再生中心
history.text: 東京都下水道局介紹有明採A₂O和生物膜過濾，部分水另經臭氧或纖維過濾供沖廁與清洗等用途。
history.textEn: Tokyo Sewerage describes A₂O and biofilm filtration at Ariake, with part of the water further ozonated or fiber-filtered for toilet flushing and washing.

courses.connection: 有明的公開流程具有厭氧、無氧、好氧與生物膜過濾，部分出水另作回用。課程讓學徒區分水質處理鏈與再生水用途鏈。
courses.connectionEn: Ariake documents anaerobic, anoxic, aerobic and biofilm-filter processes, with a portion further treated for reuse. The learner separates treatment and end-use chains.
